allow: PowerShell(& "C:\\php\\php.exe" -r "echo extension_loaded\('mbstring'\) ? 'mbstring OK' : 'mbstring MISSING'; echo PHP_EOL;")

PowerShell(Get-Process -Name "php","ngrok" -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | ForEach-Object { Write-Host "Stopping $\($_.Name\) PID $\($_.Id\)"; $_ | Stop-Process -Force }; Start-Sleep 1; $still = Get-Process -Name "php","ngrok" -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; if \($still\) { "Still running: $\($still.Name -join ', '\)" } else { "All stopped." })
